name: myatriumhealth-mcp
description: Read MyAtriumHealth (Atrium Health's Epic MyChart patient portal) — test results, medications, allergies, immunizations, health issues and visits — through your signed-in browser tab.

tools.name: mah_auth_status
tools.description: Report whether bridge-less sign-in is configured and a trusted device is stored

tools.name: mah_get_health_summary
tools.description: Fetch the health-summary header and action plans

tools.name: mah_get_menu
tools.description: List the portal features this account exposes

tools.name: mah_healthcheck
tools.description: Report fetchproxy bridge health and whether the portal session is signed in

tools.name: mah_list_allergies
tools.description: List allergies and their reactions from the health summary

tools.name: mah_list_billing_accounts
tools.description: List billing accounts and balances due, parsed from the server-rendered billing page

tools.name: mah_list_care_team
tools.description: List care team providers with specialty and relationship, internal and external

tools.name: mah_list_goals
tools.description: List patient goals tracked in MyAtriumHealth

tools.name: mah_list_health_issues
tools.description: List the problem list (current health issues)

tools.name: mah_list_immunizations
tools.description: List immunizations and administration dates by organization

tools.name: mah_list_insurance
tools.description: List insurance coverages on file, including pending and in-review coverages

tools.name: mah_list_medications
tools.description: List current medications with dosing instructions and prescriber

tools.name: mah_list_message_folders
tools.description: List Message Center folders with unread and total counts

tools.name: mah_list_messages
tools.description: List Message Center conversations for a folder, with participants, subject and date

tools.name: mah_list_past_visits
tools.description: List past visits grouped by organization

tools.name: mah_list_test_results
tools.description: List lab and imaging results with abnormal flags and provider comments

tools.name: mah_list_upcoming_visits
tools.description: List upcoming and in-progress appointments

tools.name: mah_send_verification_code
tools.description: Ask the portal to send a verification code to the account holder

tools.name: mah_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in server-side; reports the verification channels when a code is required

tools.name: mah_verify_code
tools.description: Submit the code the user received and store the portal's device-trust token
